findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "beauty" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Private data: AI-Eye-Color-Lens-Virtual-Try-On, upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Public sink: AI-Abs-Filter, AI-Smile, AI-Hair-Color-Virtual-Try-On, AI-Wavy-Hair-Virtual-Try-On, AI-Makeup-Transfer, upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Destructive: AI-Aging-Simulation, AI-Body-Reshape-Detection, AI-Face-Lift-Detection, AI-Face-Reshape-Detection, AI-Fitzpatrick-Skin-Type-Analysis-Detection, AI-Skin-Analysis, AI-Teeth-Whitening-Detection, File-Upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Private data: AI-Eye-Color-Lens-Virtual-Try-On, upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Public sink: AI-Abs-Filter, AI-Smile, AI-Hair-Color-Virtual-Try-On, AI-Wavy-Hair-Virtual-Try-On, AI-Makeup-Transfer, upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Destructive: AI-Aging-Simulation, AI-Body-Reshape-Detection, AI-Face-Lift-Detection, AI-Face-Reshape-Detection, AI-Fitzpatrick-Skin-Type-Analysis-Detection, AI-Skin-Analysis, AI-Teeth-Whitening-Detection, File-Upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
